description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_http, which models the HTTP URI scheme according to RFC 2616, including its default port, properties like browsability and hierarchical structure, and a validation method for configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_http
classes.description: A class representing the HTTP URI scheme with properties such as default port, browsability, hierarchical structure, and a method to validate the URI.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the given URI object by resetting its userinfo property and returning true.
